acceptanceCriteria: A note can pin a symbol; editing another symbol in the same file leaves it CURRENT, editing the pinned symbol makes it STALE, an unresolvable symbol reads UNKNOWN.
A re-confirm write re-pins a STALE note to the current revision with provenance; prior pins remain in history.
body: V1-0955 anchors notes to files only and has no re-confirmation write (non-goals). Add symbol anchors whose freshness follows the symbol's content, and an explicit re-confirm write that re-pins a STALE note while keeping immutable history.
